section0Intro: Welcome to the Arduino plant workshop.
section0Goal: Goal: Build and program an automatic watering system with moisture sensor + relay-controlled pump.
section0Safety: Safety: Water and electricity only with supervision. Never power the pump setup without a supervisor.
section0Status: This section is already translated into the workbook structure.
section1WiringHint: Verify each connection step-by-step before powering anything.
section1RelayInfo: Why relay? The Arduino controls the relay; the relay switches the higher-current pump circuit safely.
wiringSlideText1: Step 1: Place Arduino, relay and moisture sensor on the desk and check all cable types.
wiringSlideText2: Step 2: Connect sensor power and signal lines (D2, GND, A0) carefully.
wiringSlideText3: Step 3: Wire relay and pump path, then ask a supervisor before enabling power.
section2Goal: Goal: Switch relay output correctly using LOW/HIGH logic.
section2Instruction: Beginner mode: reorder the three pump-control lines into a valid program order.
section2BeginnerHint: Hint: Relay ON first, then wait, then OFF.
